summary: Section 14 (Community Signature & Pledge Campaign) verified end-to-end. Backend: POST /api/signatures returns 200 with DU-SIG-{COMMUNITY_UPPER}-{TIMESTAMP} and echoes community/full_name/consents. GET /api/signatures/count?community=sm-malibu returns {community,count,goal:100000} and count increments by 1 after each POST (confirmed 1 -> 2 in live test). POST /api/pledges returns 200 with DU-CERT-{COMMUNITY_UPPER}-{TIMESTAMP}. Regression: existing endpoints /api/enrollments, /api/orders, /api/tryouts, /api/badges all 200. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Home shows both new buttons 'home-join-community' (gold pill) and 'home-council-letter-pdf' (outlined). Tapping Join Community loads Community Signature screen with live counter card 'X of 100,000', 3 community pickers, 4 required consents, CAMPAIGN_DISCLAIMER note, submit button disabled until required fields + all 4 consents. After filling all fields and consents, submit navigated to confirmation with DU-SIG-* id, community crest, and buttons 'community-download-letter' and 'community-to-pledge' both visible. Tapping community-to-pledge navigates to Pledge screen with pledge-fund-{ailab,aihs}, pledge-community-*, name/email inputs (testIDs 'pledge-name'/'pledge-email' present), 5 tier buttons (100/1000/10000/100000/1000000), and pledge-submit. After submit, Pledge Confirmed screen shows crest + name + tier + DU-CERT-* id and pledge-download-cert button. Store screen shows both 'fund-ailab-pledge' and 'fund-aihs-pledge' toggle rows above the BoardingPassCards; tapping fund-ailab-pledge navigates to Pledge screen correctly. No React Native red screens or deprecated packages detected in changed code. Only console warning is a stylistic 'shadow* deprecated, use boxShadow' from a UI library — non-blocking.
action_items: Optional cleanup: shadow* style deprecation warning surfaces in browser console (from a UI helper). Not caused by Section 14 code. Consider migrating to boxShadow when convenient.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py signatures/pledges routes are clean: bounded pydantic types, UUID + timestamp id format matches spec, MongoDB _id is never returned (response_model excludes it via Signature/Pledge schemas).
index.tsx CommunityView: canSubmit correctly requires fullName, email (>3 chars), zip, signature, and all 4 consents. Best-effort fallback if fetch fails (LOCAL id) is acceptable for a demo.
Store toggle rows for fund-ailab-pledge / fund-aihs-pledge both point to the same onPledge handler which is fine (Pledge screen has its own fund picker).
Live counter effect correctly re-fetches on community change and cleans up via ok flag.
index.tsx is ~1400+ lines — consider splitting into per-screen files in a future refactor (not blocking).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all Section 14 flows and regressions tested (Home entry points, Community screen submit, Confirmation, Store->Pledge, Pledge submit, Pledge Confirmed)

seed_data_creation: One TEST_ signature and one TEST_ pledge were POSTed during live-endpoint verification; both stored in db.signatures / db.pledges. Non-destructive.

Frontend flows Home -> Community -> Confirmation -> Pledge and Store -> Pledge all pass on mobile viewport. Only cosmetic warning: 'shadow*' style deprecation from a third-party UI library — safe to ignore.
